description: Publishes an activity to your agent’s session and updates its lifecycle. Thoughts and actions report ongoing work; a response completes the turn unless it has the continue signal, an elicitation waits for user input, and an error records a failed turn. The session must be unarchived and owned by the authenticated app user. Use the agent app’s OAuth or workload identity token; personal API keys cannot publish agent activities.

input.description: The agent activity object to create.

selection.description: Optional GraphQL selection set override, e.g. `{ id title }`. Omit for the default selection.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

agentSessionId.description: The UUID of the unarchived session to publish to. The session’s appUser must be the user represented by your agent token; an app cannot publish activities to another agent’s session.

signal.description: An optional instruction for handling the content. Use continue only with a response to keep the turn active. Use auth or select only with an elicitation, and provide the matching signalMetadata. stop is reserved for user prompts and cannot be published through agentActivityCreate. Omit this field for normal handling.

signalMetadata.description: Details required by auth and select signals. For auth, provide a valid url, optionally providerName, and optionally a userId UUID identifying who should authenticate. That userId limits the authentication control in Linear, not access to the activity. For select, provide options: an array of 1–100 objects with a nonempty value and optional label, each up to 256 characters. Omit this field for other signals.

contextualMetadata.description: Metadata about user-provided contextual information for this agent activity.

content.description: The activity as a JSON object. Use {type: "thought", body: "Searching the repository"} for progress, response for an answer, error for a failure, or elicitation to ask for input. These types require a Markdown body. An action instead requires action and parameter strings, and may include a Markdown result. body and result each accept up to 250,000 characters. A response normally completes the turn; add signal: continue when more work follows.

ephemeral.description: Hide this activity after the next activity. Defaults to false; only thought and action activities can be ephemeral.

description: Starts an active session for your authenticated agent app on an existing issue comment thread. Supply the UUID of an unarchived root comment; replies and threads that already have a session are rejected. The caller must have access to the issue. Use the returned session ID when publishing activities.

input.description: The agent session object to create.

selection.description: Optional GraphQL selection set override, e.g. `{ id title }`. Omit for the default selection.

url.description: The URL of the external resource.

commentId.description: UUID of an unarchived root comment on an issue. Replies and comments with an existing agent session are not accepted.

externalLink.description: The URL of an external agent-hosted page associated with this session.

externalUrls.description: External links to associate with the new session. Each entry contains a url and label; URLs must be unique within the list. If omitted, a supplied externalLink is added with the agent’s name as its label.

description: Starts an active session for your authenticated agent app and creates its comment thread on the issue. The issue must be accessible and writable. Supply its UUID or identifier, then use the returned session ID to publish progress and results with agentActivityCreate.

input.description: The agent session object to create.

selection.description: Optional GraphQL selection set override, e.g. `{ id title }`. Omit for the default selection.

url.description: The URL of the external resource.

issueId.description: The issue that this session will be associated with. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

externalLink.description: The URL of an external agent-hosted page associated with this session.

externalUrls.description: External links to associate with the new session. Each entry contains a url and label; URLs must be unique within the list. If omitted, a supplied externalLink is added with the agent’s name as its label.

description: Updates your agent’s session title, external links, or plan. Only the app user that owns the session can change these fields. Omitted fields remain unchanged, while each supplied plan or externalUrls list replaces that value. Updates other than a title-only change acknowledge a pending or stale session by making it active; publishing an activity still determines the next turn status.

input.description: A partial agent session object to update the agent session with.

id.description: The identifier of the agent session to update.

selection.description: Optional GraphQL selection set override, e.g. `{ id title }`. Omit for the default selection.

url.description: The URL of the external resource.

summary.description: The session title, displayed as its summary. Must contain 1 to 255 characters, including a non-whitespace character, with no line breaks or NUL bytes. Set to null to clear it and allow automatic title generation. Updating only this field does not acknowledge the session. Only updatable by the OAuth application that owns the session or by the user who created the session.

externalLink.description: The agent’s external session URL. Setting a URL also adds it to externalUrls with the agent’s name as its label. Null clears this field but leaves entries in externalUrls; use removedExternalUrls to remove those links.

externalUrls.description: Replaces all external URLs. Pass an empty list to clear them. Cannot be combined with addedExternalUrls or removedExternalUrls; only the owning app can update this field.

addedExternalUrls.description: Adds URLs or updates labels for existing URLs. Cannot be combined with externalUrls; only the owning app can update this field.

removedExternalUrls.description: Removes exact URL matches. A URL cannot also be added in the same request; only the owning app can update this field.

plan.description: Replacement JSON array of 1 to 100 plan entries. Each entry must contain only content (1 to 10,000 characters) and status (pending, inProgress, completed, or canceled). Only the owning app can update it. Null clears the plan, while omission keeps it unchanged. Non-null plan updates are ignored while the session is in its error state.

addedExternalUrls.description: Adds URLs or updates labels for existing URLs. Cannot be combined with externalUrls.

removedExternalUrls.description: Removes exact URL matches. A URL cannot also be added in the same request.

title.description: The title shown in issue lists and at the top of the issue. Required unless templateId is provided; when supplied with a template, it replaces the template’s title.

description.description: The issue’s description in Markdown. Use it for the context, requirements, and links that do not belong in the title. When creating from a template, a supplied description replaces the template’s description.

assigneeId.description: The UUID of the user responsible for the issue. Omit it to use the template’s assignee, if any, or pass null to leave that default unset. Team triage rules can still assign an unassigned issue.

delegateId.description: The UUID of an agent user to delegate work to. Delegation can start an agent session on the issue and requires permission to invoke that agent.

parentId.description: The UUID or identifier of an existing parent issue, such as ENG-123. Setting this makes the new issue a sub-issue; the parent can belong to another team if you can access it.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

estimate.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64. Linear maps it to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale; use numeric values even for T-shirt sizes. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Omit to use the template’s estimate, if any, or pass null for no estimate.

subscriberIds.description: The UUIDs of users to subscribe to issue updates. Linear may also subscribe people involved in the issue, such as its assignee and users mentioned in the description.

labelIds.description: The UUIDs of labels to apply. Labels must be available to the issue’s team, and a single-select group can contribute at most one label. When using a template, these labels are combined with its labels, with your choice taking precedence within a single-select group.

teamId.description: UUID of the team that will own the issue.

cycleId.description: The UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. When a cycle is supplied without a status, the issue starts in the team’s default unstarted status. Team cycle settings can also assign a cycle automatically when you leave this unset.

projectId.description: UUID or identifier of the project, such as P-LIN-123. The project must include the issue’s team. If omitted for a sub-issue, the parent’s project is used when it includes that team; null leaves the issue without a project.

projectMilestoneId.description: The UUID of a milestone in the project supplied in projectId. A milestone cannot be assigned without its project.

lastAppliedTemplateId.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Use templateId to apply its values.

stateId.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. Defaults to the team’s initial status, or an unstarted status when cycleId is set.

referenceCommentId.description: The UUID of a comment whose issue should be linked to the new issue. If the comment belongs to an issue, Linear creates a related-issue relation between that issue and the new one.

sourceCommentId.description: The UUID of the comment from which this issue was created. Records the source comment on the issue; use referenceCommentId to also link to the comment’s issue.

sortOrder.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first. Set preserveSortOrderOnCreate to keep this position.

prioritySortOrder.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

subIssueSortOrder.description: The position among the parent’s direct sub-issues, with lower values first. Requires parentId. If omitted, the new sub-issue is placed last; conflicting positions are adjusted.

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone.

createAsUser.description: Display name credited with creating the issue. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

displayIconUrl.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

preserveSortOrderOnCreate.description: Keep the supplied sortOrder instead of placing the issue first in its status. Defaults to false.

createdAt.description: Creation time for imported issues. Must be in the past. Defaults to the current time.

templateId.description: The UUID of an issue template to use. Linear applies its defaults and creates any sub-issues it defines, returning the root issue. Supplied values override the template’s defaults; labelIds are combined with its labels.

completedAt.description: Completion time for an imported issue. Requires createdAt and a completed status; must be in the past and not before createdAt.

slaType.description: The SLA day count type for the issue. Whether SLA should be business days only or calendar days (default).

useDefaultTemplate.description: Whether to apply the team’s default template. Linear selects the member or non-member default based on your team membership; if no matching default is set, creation proceeds without a template. Cannot be combined with templateId.

releaseIds.description: The UUIDs of releases to associate with the new issue. Requires release management to be available in the workspace; the releases must exist and be accessible to you.

issues.description: The issues to create, in creation order. Put parents before their sub-issues so each parent exists when its children are created.

selection.description: Optional GraphQL selection set override, e.g. `{ id title }`. Omit for the default selection.

title.description: The replacement issue title. Omit to keep the current title; an empty string or null is not accepted.

description.description: The replacement issue description in Markdown. Send an empty string to clear it, or omit this field to keep the current description. Null also leaves it unchanged. This replaces the full description rather than appending to it.

assigneeId.description: UUID of the new assignee. Null unassigns the issue.

delegateId.description: The UUID of the agent to delegate work to. Changing the delegate can start an agent session; pass null to remove the delegate, or omit this field to keep the current one.

parentId.description: The UUID or identifier of the new parent issue, such as ENG-123. Pass null to make this a top-level issue, or omit it to keep the current parent. An issue cannot be its own ancestor.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

estimate.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64, mapped to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Pass null to clear the estimate, or omit it to keep the current value.

subscriberIds.description: The complete replacement list of subscriber UUIDs. An empty list removes the current subscribers; omitting the field keeps them. Assignee, delegate, or mention changes can add subscribers as part of the same update.

labelIds.description: Replacement list of label UUIDs. An empty list removes all labels. Cannot be combined with addedLabelIds or removedLabelIds.

addedLabelIds.description: Label UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

removedLabelIds.description: Label UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

releaseIds.description: Replacement list of release UUIDs. An empty list removes all release links. Cannot be combined with addedReleaseIds or removedReleaseIds.

addedReleaseIds.description: Release UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

removedReleaseIds.description: Release UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

teamId.description: The UUID of the destination team. Moving an issue gives it a new team identifier and maps team-specific values, such as status and labels, to the destination team. Its UUID and previous identifiers are preserved.

cycleId.description: UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. Null removes the cycle, subject to the team’s automatic cycle assignment settings.

projectId.description: UUID or identifier of a project that includes the issue’s team. Null removes the project and milestone.

projectMilestoneId.description: UUID of a milestone in the issue’s project. Null removes the milestone.

lastAppliedTemplateId.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Does not apply template values. Pass null to clear the recorded template, or omit to keep it.

stateId.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. A status change updates lifecycle times and may change cycle membership. Moving to the reserved duplicate status requires an existing duplicate relation; use issueRelationCreate to mark an issue as a duplicate.

sortOrder.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first.

prioritySortOrder.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

subIssueSortOrder.description: Position among the parent’s sub-issues. Lower values appear first.

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone. Null clears it.

inheritsSharedAccess.description: Whether people with shared access to the parent also receive access to this issue. Setting true requires a parent issue. Omit this field to keep the current setting.

trashed.description: The trash marker for an already archived issue. Set true to mark it as trashed, or null to remove that marker while keeping it archived. Use issueDelete to trash an active issue and issueUnarchive to restore it to normal issue lists.

snoozedUntilAt.description: The time until which to hide the issue from triage. Pass null to clear the snooze. Linear records the acting user as snoozedBy when a snooze is set.

snoozedById.description: The UUID of the user recorded as snoozing the issue. For API requests, Linear sets this from the acting user when snoozedUntilAt changes; you cannot change it independently.

slaType.description: How to count time for the issue’s SLA: all for calendar days, or onlyBusinessDays for the team’s working days. Omit it to keep the current setting. Changing it recalculates the risk thresholds for an existing SLA.

autoClosedByParentClosing.description: Record that this status change was caused by closing the parent issue. Requires stateId.

description: Creates an issue in the chosen team and returns it with its assigned identifier. You can supply a template to populate defaults and create any sub-issues it defines. Team settings and automation may set values such as the initial status, assignee, and cycle.

input.description: The issue object to create.

selection.description: Optional GraphQL selection set override, e.g. `{ id title }`. Omit for the default selection.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

title.description: The title shown in issue lists and at the top of the issue. Required unless templateId is provided; when supplied with a template, it replaces the template’s title.

description.description: The issue’s description in Markdown. Use it for the context, requirements, and links that do not belong in the title. When creating from a template, a supplied description replaces the template’s description.

assigneeId.description: The UUID of the user responsible for the issue. Omit it to use the template’s assignee, if any, or pass null to leave that default unset. Team triage rules can still assign an unassigned issue.

delegateId.description: The UUID of an agent user to delegate work to. Delegation can start an agent session on the issue and requires permission to invoke that agent.

parentId.description: The UUID or identifier of an existing parent issue, such as ENG-123. Setting this makes the new issue a sub-issue; the parent can belong to another team if you can access it.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

estimate.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64. Linear maps it to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale; use numeric values even for T-shirt sizes. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Omit to use the template’s estimate, if any, or pass null for no estimate.

subscriberIds.description: The UUIDs of users to subscribe to issue updates. Linear may also subscribe people involved in the issue, such as its assignee and users mentioned in the description.

labelIds.description: The UUIDs of labels to apply. Labels must be available to the issue’s team, and a single-select group can contribute at most one label. When using a template, these labels are combined with its labels, with your choice taking precedence within a single-select group.

teamId.description: UUID of the team that will own the issue.

cycleId.description: The UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. When a cycle is supplied without a status, the issue starts in the team’s default unstarted status. Team cycle settings can also assign a cycle automatically when you leave this unset.

projectId.description: UUID or identifier of the project, such as P-LIN-123. The project must include the issue’s team. If omitted for a sub-issue, the parent’s project is used when it includes that team; null leaves the issue without a project.

projectMilestoneId.description: The UUID of a milestone in the project supplied in projectId. A milestone cannot be assigned without its project.

lastAppliedTemplateId.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Use templateId to apply its values.

stateId.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. Defaults to the team’s initial status, or an unstarted status when cycleId is set.

referenceCommentId.description: The UUID of a comment whose issue should be linked to the new issue. If the comment belongs to an issue, Linear creates a related-issue relation between that issue and the new one.

sourceCommentId.description: The UUID of the comment from which this issue was created. Records the source comment on the issue; use referenceCommentId to also link to the comment’s issue.

sortOrder.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first. Set preserveSortOrderOnCreate to keep this position.

prioritySortOrder.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

subIssueSortOrder.description: The position among the parent’s direct sub-issues, with lower values first. Requires parentId. If omitted, the new sub-issue is placed last; conflicting positions are adjusted.

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone.

createAsUser.description: Display name credited with creating the issue. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

displayIconUrl.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

preserveSortOrderOnCreate.description: Keep the supplied sortOrder instead of placing the issue first in its status. Defaults to false.

createdAt.description: Creation time for imported issues. Must be in the past. Defaults to the current time.

templateId.description: The UUID of an issue template to use. Linear applies its defaults and creates any sub-issues it defines, returning the root issue. Supplied values override the template’s defaults; labelIds are combined with its labels.

completedAt.description: Completion time for an imported issue. Requires createdAt and a completed status; must be in the past and not before createdAt.

slaType.description: The SLA day count type for the issue. Whether SLA should be business days only or calendar days (default).

useDefaultTemplate.description: Whether to apply the team’s default template. Linear selects the member or non-member default based on your team membership; if no matching default is set, creation proceeds without a template. Cannot be combined with templateId.

releaseIds.description: The UUIDs of releases to associate with the new issue. Requires release management to be available in the workspace; the releases must exist and be accessible to you.

description: Moves an issue to the trash and trashes its unarchived sub-issues that you can access. Trashed issues can be restored during the 30-day grace period; permanentlyDelete skips that period and requires workspace entity-management permission.

permanentlyDelete.description: Delete immediately, skipping the 30-day grace period. Requires workspace permission to manage entities and access to the issue’s team.

updatedAt.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window.

number.description: Matches the issue number within its team. Numbers are not unique across teams, so combine this with team when looking for a specific issue.

title.description: Conditions on the issue title. This does not search descriptions or comments.

description.description: Conditions on the issue’s stored description text. Use null to find issues without a stored description, or text comparisons to match its contents.

priority.description: Conditions on the numeric priority: 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low. Lower nonzero values mean higher priority.

estimate.description: Conditions on the stored numeric estimate in the team’s scale. Use null to find unestimated issues; zero is a separate, explicit estimate.

startedAt.description: Conditions on when work started. Use null: true for issues with no recorded start time; moving back to triage, backlog, or an unstarted status clears it.

triagedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue last left triage. The value is unset before triage is completed and after re-entering triage.

completedAt.description: Conditions on the recorded completion time. Use null: false to require a completion time, or a date range to find issues completed during that period.

canceledAt.description: Conditions on when the issue entered a canceled or duplicate status. The value is cleared when the issue leaves those status types.

slaBreachesAt.description: Conditions on the SLA deadline. A deadline before now does not by itself mean the SLA was missed; use slaStatus to distinguish unfinished breaches from completed outcomes.

archivedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was archived. Also set includeArchived on the query; a filter alone does not include records excluded by the query’s archive setting.

autoClosedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically closed after inactivity. The value is cleared when its status changes.

autoArchivedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically archived. Include archived issues in the query to find them; restoring an issue clears this value.

addedToCycleAt.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its current cycle. Changing cycles resets this time; removing the cycle clears it.

addedToCyclePeriod.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its cycle. before includes the cycle’s first 24 hours; during covers the remaining time before closure, and after covers times at or after closure.

dueDate.description: Conditions on the due date, without a time of day. Use null: true for issues without a due date.

accumulatedStateUpdatedAt.description: Comparator for the issue's accumulatedStateUpdatedAt date.

snoozedUntilAt.description: Conditions on when the issue’s triage snooze ends. Use null: true for issues without a recorded snooze time.

hasDuplicateRelations.description: Whether other issues have been marked as duplicates of this issue. This checks incoming duplicate links, not whether this issue is itself a duplicate.

hasBlockedByRelations.description: Whether another issue blocks this issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead.

hasBlockingRelations.description: Whether this issue blocks another issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead.

hasErroredAgentSessions.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having an errored agent session, no active sessions, and no merged agent pull requests.

hasMergedAgentPullRequests.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have agent-session-linked pull requests that were merged.

Important requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerImportantCount conditions in and.

ageTime.description: Compares the elapsed time from creation to the start of the query's database transaction. The duration is null for completed or canceled issues. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or milliseconds.

triageTime.description: Compares the elapsed time from entering triage to leaving triage. The duration is null if either timestamp is missing. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or milliseconds.

startedAt.description: Conditions on when work started. Use null: true for issues with no recorded start time; moving back to triage, backlog, or an unstarted status clears it.

triagedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue last left triage. The value is unset before triage is completed and after re-entering triage.

completedAt.description: Conditions on the recorded completion time. Use null: false to require a completion time, or a date range to find issues completed during that period.

canceledAt.description: Conditions on when the issue entered a canceled or duplicate status. The value is cleared when the issue leaves those status types.

slaBreachesAt.description: Conditions on the SLA deadline. A deadline before now does not by itself mean the SLA was missed; use slaStatus to distinguish unfinished breaches from completed outcomes.

archivedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was archived. Also set includeArchived on the query; a filter alone does not include records excluded by the query’s archive setting.

autoClosedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically closed after inactivity. The value is cleared when its status changes.

autoArchivedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically archived. Include archived issues in the query to find them; restoring an issue clears this value.

addedToCycleAt.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its current cycle. Changing cycles resets this time; removing the cycle clears it.

addedToCyclePeriod.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its cycle. before includes the cycle’s first 24 hours; during covers the remaining time before closure, and after covers times at or after closure.

dueDate.description: Conditions on the due date, without a time of day. Use null: true for issues without a due date.

accumulatedStateUpdatedAt.description: Comparator for the issue's accumulatedStateUpdatedAt date.

snoozedUntilAt.description: Conditions on when the issue’s triage snooze ends. Use null: true for issues without a recorded snooze time.
